exportWells: Direct USDZ point inspection proves both rear4mm wells and side mouths exist; front-on equal-face lighting can hide shallow recesses. No tag correction indicated.

shortCordRecommendation.visualJudgment: Both whole-body front/side/oblique/top route sheets reviewed: distinct front/back-side bearing tracks, rim turns and outlet turns stay on actual supported surfaces. No distant free-air knee or body penetration demonstrated.
shortCordRecommendation.scope: All cord lengths, chosen support and section-plane tilts are display adaptations. Four visible leads do not assert the unproven hidden end-mouth/rear-well connections. Clearance and static visual plausibility do not certify global frictional equilibrium.
